_README: Reserved curated deity signals: declared (Int Property SIGNAL_X) and handled in ScoreCuratedSignal, but INTENTIONALLY not yet dispatched from a real trigger. Each key is <DeityProp>.<SIGNAL_NAME>. The dispatch-coverage audit (tools/pdv_signal_e2e_gate.mjs -> evaluateCuratedSignalDispatchCoverage) reports a listed key as a documented KNOWN-GAP instead of failing. Any undispatched+scored signal NOT listed here is a HARD FAIL. Delete an entry when you wire the signal (a stale entry -- now dispatched or no longer declared -- also FAILs). Seeded 2026-07-06 from the curated-signal wiring audit; shrink toward empty by 1.0. NOTE 2026-07-12: registry reconciled into main from worktree great-lewin (the dispatch-coverage gate tooling itself still lives on branch claude/great-lewin-c094ed pending merge). Burned this date: Khenarthi OPEN_ROAD (removed const), Khenarthi CARAVAN_AID + Rajhin LEGEND_MADE + Mephala WEB_WOVEN + Boethiah HONORABLE_DUEL (wired).
